items.title: Kenny Burrell — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I called Dr. Turnbull and said, “Would you be interested in working with me? I’m going to write something with you guys in mind.” He said “Of course!”

ctx.x: [laughs] …so they said “Well, we want to give you a commission,” so I dove right into it, started thinking about it, and I called Dr. Turnbull and said, “Would you be interested in working with me? I’m going to write something with you guys in mind.” He said “Of course!” So I began. I began the piece. But at the same time, I was asked to write something for that PhD thing I was doing.
And what was that? What program was that?
